channel.title: Blockchain Today
channel.description: Blockchain Today reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and network upgrades, with analysis of what changed.

item.title: FBI links Binance’s $6.3bn theft to North Korea
item.description: FBI attributes Binance’s $6.3 billion theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group, urging crypto services to block addresses as funds move into Ether.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7, cutting target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target blocks to 25 seconds while capping shielded activity and reserving fees for future mining rewards.

item.title: What SunSwap Lets You Reuse Between Trades
item.description: A token approval may carry over, but each SunSwap trade needs a fresh quote and wallet confirmation; learn what stays in place and what to check again.

item.title: Binance’s $6.3B theft exposes the cost of hot-wallet access
item.description: Binance says attackers drained about $6.34 billion through hot-wallet signing access; it has replenished 98% while tracing frozen assets and reopening withdrawals.

item.title: Fraxswap on Fraxtal: Why Its Pools Keep Separate Liquidity
item.description: Fraxswap on Fraxtal uses its own token-pair pools, so prices, depth and execution depend on liquidity on that network rather than Ethereum balances.

item.title: South Korea proposes fourth delay to crypto tax, until 2029
item.description: South Korea will ask lawmakers to move crypto income tax from 2027 to 2029, citing delayed US data sharing and unfinished rules as a fourth postponement looms.

item.title: NEAR holders back a gradual cut to 1.6% issuance
item.description: NEAR’s House of Stake approved a two-year issuance cut, but the 2.5% ceiling remains until council review, a grace period and validator adoption are complete.

item.title: Binance expands withdrawals after $6.3bn hot-wallet breach
item.description: Binance began a phased reopening of withdrawals after a $6.3bn hot-wallet breach; trading continued, while security checks still govern access to funds.

item.title: FBI links record $6bn Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI tied Binance’s record theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor, as stolen assets move into Ethereum and crypto services face pressure to block laundering.

item.title: FBI links $6.3bn Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance, naming TraderTraitor and urging crypto firms to block laundering routes before funds move.

item.title: Binance suspends withdrawals after $6.3 billion hack
item.description: Binance says a breach drained about $6.3 billion from hot wallets; withdrawals are paused as it funds a user backstop and partners try to freeze assets.

item.title: TRM links Binance’s $6.36B theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: TRM links a $6.36 billion Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor unit; Binance says it will cover losses and has frozen about $3 billion.

item.title: DTCC launches tokenization service for $30 trillion in securities
item.description: DTCC launched tokenized versions of 34 securities across two networks, bringing a $30 trillion pool within reach of approved firms while keeping custody at DTC.

item.title: Ripple says OCC finalized national trust bank charter
item.description: Ripple says its trust bank has final OCC approval, adding federal supervision to RLUSD’s reserve management while its New York trust company continues issuance.

item.title: Aviva adds XRP Ledger share class to £22bn sterling fund
item.description: Aviva and Ripple put a sterling fund share class on XRP Ledger, extending a July dollar launch while leaving the £22bn fund’s assets and structure off-chain.

item.title: Aviva adds £22bn sterling fund share class to XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors has put a tokenised share class of its £22bn sterling liquidity fund on XRPL, extending its Ripple partnership while keeping the fund structure off-chain.

item.title: Wall Street banks move tokenized deposits toward live use
item.description: Wells Fargo plans tokenized deposits for corporate clients, adding to bank blockchain services that promise around-the-clock transfers but depend on connecting separate networks.

item.title: Kraken wins Kazakhstan approval, but licence remains ahead
item.description: AFSA has advanced Kraken parent Payward’s Kazakhstan application for trading, dealing and custody, but a full licence and customer launch still lie ahead.

item.title: SushiSwap trades and liquidity: how the costs work
item.description: SushiSwap uses automated pools to set prices and route trades; the fee, gas cost and liquidity risks depend on the pool type and the assets you choose.

item.title: HSBC brings HKD stablecoin RedCoin to PayMe users
item.description: HSBC has launched its HKD stablecoin through PayMe, giving more than 3.3 million users a new payment option while setting up a test of retail demand and trust.
